disposition: one person reported bleeding; suspect vehicle described; area checked
summary: Officers and medics were sent after a caller reported a man got out of a white four-door sedan, pointed a gun in the air and fired one round, and that a person was bleeding. A second party was reported to have driven a white four-door to a nearby motel, and units were checking the area.

area: Chester Avenue near Decatur Street, Bakersfield
disposition: victim walked in; deputies and a fire crew sent
summary: A person walked into a business on Chester Avenue with a stab wound, and deputies and a fire crew were sent to the area around Decatur Street and North Chester Avenue.

disposition: units covering the perimeter; audible alarm
summary: Units started to an audible burglary alarm at a home on Millwood Way to cover the perimeter and the living room door, with cross streets at Thornwood Drive and Woodcastle Way.

agency: California Highway Patrol and Kern County fire crews
area: eastbound Highway 46 west of Interstate 5, Kern County
disposition: two semis stuck together; traffic diverted
summary: Two semis collided in the eastbound lanes of Highway 46 west of Interstate 5, a maroon semi with a silver trailer and a Walmart semi, and came to rest stuck together in the roadway. Crews reported a backup and an exit closed while drivers were routed around.

area: westbound Highway 58 west of General Beale Road, Bakersfield
disposition: semi on fire; grass fire in the same stretch knocked down
summary: A semi was reported on fire in the westbound lanes of Highway 58 and fire crews from a nearby station responded, with a grass fire in the same stretch brought under control a short time later.

disposition: video alarm; multiple units sent
summary: Multiple units were sent to a Dollar General on Niles Street after a video alarm showed two people inside, both in black tops and jeans, with a possible third person in a white shirt.

area: Hall Road near the Rasmussen Center, Bakersfield
disposition: caller reported shots into a field; area checked
summary: A caller reported someone firing shots into a field on the western end of Hall Road near the Rasmussen Center, and a deputy asked to be stopped where the caller believed the shots were fired.

area: East Brundage Lane and Kincaid Street, Bakersfield
disposition: rollover; rescue response; all parties out
summary: A silver sedan rolled over in the area of East Brundage Lane and Kincaid Street and a full rescue response was sent. All parties were reported out of the vehicles.

disposition: access slowed by railroad crossing; upgraded as a precaution
summary: Crews were sent to a fire in the field just west of 84 Lumber on the westbound Highway 58 embankment. Access was slowed because the railroad crossing arms were down, and the call was upgraded to a critical medical aid as a precaution.

area: Washington Street near the rail tracks, Bakersfield
disposition: subject ran west across the tracks; perimeter set
summary: A person took off on a quad from a unit, ditched it and ran west across the rail tracks, and units set a perimeter while a drone was brought in.

agency: California Highway Patrol and Kern County fire crews
disposition: lanes reopened except the number 1 lane
summary: Caltrans asked the CHP to close all but one lane of northbound Interstate 5 at Gorman for traffic exiting at Lebec. Fire crews later gave the go-ahead to reopen all lanes except the number 1 lane at the west ramp.

disposition: threats reported; officers responding
summary: Officers were sent after a caller reported a man wrapped in a black blanket who had threatened to shoot people using an ATM and had previously shown a handgun.

disposition: caller reported a person with weapons
summary: Deputies were asked to respond to the riverbed south of Hart Street after a caller reported a person with weapons while he was getting his belongings from an encampment.

area: Panama Road and Cottonwood Road, Bakersfield
disposition: crew sent to a vehicle fire
summary: A crew was sent to a vehicle fire just north of Panama Road and Cottonwood Road.

disposition: vehicle located
summary: An officer reported a stolen vehicle in the 1200 block of East 21st Street.

area: Taft Highway near Hughes Lane, Bakersfield
disposition: business cleared
summary: An alarm company reported a glass break at an auto parts business on Taft Highway near Hughes Lane. Units reported the business had been cleared.

disposition: crew sent
summary: A crew was sent to a medical aid in the Ponce de Leon Avenue area.

disposition: crew sent
summary: A crew was sent to a medical aid on Primrose Avenue.

area: White Lane and Hughes Lane, Bakersfield
disposition: crew sent to an unknown medical aid
summary: A crew was sent to an unknown medical aid at White Lane and Hughes Lane.

disposition: engine sent
summary: An engine was sent to a medical aid on North King Street.

disposition: crew sent for difficulty breathing
summary: A crew was sent to a medical aid on Colton Street for difficulty breathing.

disposition: deputies sent
summary: Deputies were sent to a welfare check on Lake Street for a person reported to be in crisis.

area: south of Grapevine in the center divide
disposition: crews sent to check
summary: A caller reported a small fire in the center divide south of Grapevine, and crews were sent to check the area.

area: Henry Street and Cherry Street, Bakersfield
disposition: engine sent
summary: An engine was sent to investigate smoke at Henry Street and Cherry Street.
